consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: vendor notification - premature wear on CONV-CLASS-A

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on CV-3100 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. CV-3100 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 13 November 2024 the original equipment manufacturer issued an advisory affecting CV-3100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
